mapper.select: SELECT * FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT * FROM course WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course (course_name, course_code, course_target, course_type, credit_hours, credits, status, user_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{courseName}, #{courseCode}, #{courseTarget}, #{courseType}, #{creditHours}, #{credits}, #{status}, #{userId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET course_name = #{courseName}, course_code = #{courseCode}, course_target = #{courseTarget}, course_type = #{courseType}, credit_hours = #{creditHours}, credits = #{credits}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM course WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
